strategic_context: Tank divisions were formed largely by regrouping existing regiments, not by creating an entirely new national tank fleet.
Branch Five-Go starts 1943-03-25 and uses the 3rd Tank Division heavily on suitable terrain, while its larger bottlenecks are rail, rolling stock, trucks, engineers, fuel and ammunition.
China and southern campaigns continue to validate reliable 15-17t vehicles; no reason yet for a mass 30t-tank switch.
GALVANIC in Nov1943 creates a qualitatively new M4/Sherman anti-armor requirement late in the year.

Shinhoto_new_hulls.note: The widely cited 427 is retained as an upper/source-series anchor, not asserted as an archival Jan-Dec total.

HaGo_new_hulls.note: Common 239 annual figure is treated as a scaffold pending fiscal-source transcription.

KeNi_new_hulls.note: Primary-document reconstruction strongly rejects the old 79/89 mass-production figure; FY1943 actual completions were about 15.

ChiHe_new_hulls.note: Branch may close development several weeks/months earlier, but JGSDF chronology still puts historical development completion Jun1943 and mass production spring1944.

HoNiII_new_hulls.note: First prototype 1942, series from 1943; total wartime 54 is a broad secondary anchor, annual split remains OPEN.

Shinhoto_old_hull_retrofit_1943.interpretation: Branch essentially completes the known old-hull conversion program during 1943. This changes gun mix, not physical hull count.

branch_production_policy.national_hull_inflation: LOW. Keep total tracked-AFV new-build close to historical-equivalent envelope.
model_mix: End new 57mm Type97 construction except residual contracts.
Make Shinhoto the normal new medium tank.
Keep Ha-Go production/use because China/South reward a reliable light tank.
Keep Ke-Ni extremely low priority; use freed planning/plant attention on recovery tractors, spares, workshops and special AFVs.
Run Chi-He as a quality/pilot line, not a 1943 mass replacement.
Expand mobile artillery/SPG modestly where it directly supports tank divisions.
branch_production_policy.branch_extra_resources_first_destination: spares, recovery, tractors, radios, workshop throughput, gun/turret QC; not a large extra hull count

FiveGo_and_3rd_Tank_Division.formation: 3rd Tank Division formed Dec1942 in China from existing armored formations; Five-Go does not wait for 1943 new production.

working_divisional_physical_tank_wallet_.note: Band follows four-regiment/tank-division scale and allows understrength/equipment-transition; exact regiment ledger still to be built.

medium_mix_at_1943_03_25_center.reason: Branch prewar/1942 retrofit accelerates 47mm share, but China does not need or receive every new 47mm vehicle.

serviceability.reason: Branch reliability/maintenance plus a long prepared logistics buildup; terrain/supply still gate tactical contact.

FiveGo_and_3rd_Tank_Division.FiveGo_retroactive_effect: Re-open local tank-vs-AT engagements and operational reappearance where the old settlement used generic Type97/Type95. Do not change Five-Go strategic outcome merely from model mix.

ChiHe_1943_branch_timeline.historical_anchor: development complete around Jun1943; historical mass production spring1944
ChiHe_1943_branch_timeline.why_not_mass: Shinhoto is good enough in China/South; steel/engine/factory and air/naval priorities remain real.

GALVANIC_feedback_gate.effect: 47mm medium-tank system is reclassified as insufficient for frontal anti-M4 combat.
candidate_actions: accelerate Chi-He regular line because its chassis/crew/radio/armor are useful even if 47mm is not the final anti-M4 answer
issue a stopgap 75mm-medium-tank requirement using the Chi-He/Type97 family and existing 75mm gun experience
raise priority of Ho-Ni/AT-gun mobile reserve solutions
raise Chi-To long-75mm priority without pretending it is ready for 1944H1 mass combat
GALVANIC_feedback_gate.no_auto_grant: No Chi-Nu-equivalent combat vehicle exists in 1943.

end_1943_branch_state_center.medium_fleet: Shinhoto is the normal modern medium type; large numbers of 57mm Type97 remain intentionally useful for infantry-support work.
end_1943_branch_state_center.light_fleet: Ha-Go remains the dominant field light tank; Ke-Ni is a tiny side line.
end_1943_branch_state_center.next_generation: Chi-He is pilot/pre-series, not yet a mass field type.
end_1943_branch_state_center.75mm_stopgap: requirement can be opened by GALVANIC; design/prototype work begins only after explicit Dec43/Jan44 decision.
end_1943_branch_state_center.production_focus: physical fleet improvement comes as much from conversion/serviceability/support as from new-hull totals.

next_required: Build 3rd Tank Division regiment-by-regiment March/June 1943 vehicle ledger and recheck Five-Go local engagements.
Build 1944 Jan-Jun Chi-He + stopgap75mm + Shinhoto tail monthly ledger.
Audit 75mm gun/turret/engine/armor-plate manufacturing wallet before assigning any Chi-Nu-equivalent production date.
Then reopen Saipan and 1944 China tank OOB.
